chunks: Whatever is in it from Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bukhturī, I have narrated it from my father; and from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with them both—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah; and from ʿAbd Allah ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī together, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bukhturī al-Kūfī.

key_terms.الْكُوفِيِّ: Al-Kufi; identifying the narrator’s affiliation with Kufa
key_terms.جَمِيعًا: Together; indicating that both named transmitters share in the route of transmission
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: May Allah be pleased with them both; an honorific supplication for two persons
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a technical hadith term indicating narration through a chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bukhturī in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bukhturī al-Kūfī in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the precise chain of transmission and preserving hadith-source attribution within Shia hadith scholarship.
